arxiv-1806-11476.title: A Predictable Incentive Mechanism for TrueBit
arxiv-1806-11476.creator: Julia Koch, Christian Reitwießner
arxiv-1806-11476.description: Abstract TrueBit [ TR17 ] is a protocol that uses interactive verification to allow a resource-constrained computation environment like a blockchain to perform much larger computations than usual in a trusted way. As long as a single honest participant is present to verify the computation, an invalid computation cannot get accepted.

arxiv-2109-08330.title: Mass Segmentation in Automated 3-D Breast Ultrasound Using Dual-Path U-net Journal: Computers in Biology and Medicine
arxiv-2109-08330.creator: Hamed Fayyaz, Ehsan Kozegar, Tao Tan, Mohsen Soryani
arxiv-2109-08330.description: Abstract Automated 3-D breast ultrasound (ABUS) is a newfound system for breast screening that has been proposed as a supplementary modality to mammography for breast cancer detection. While ABUS has better performance in dense breasts, reading ABUS images is exhausting and time-consuming. So, a computer-aided detection system is necessary for interpretation of these images.

arxiv-2201-05143.title: Evaporation of microwave-shielded polar molecules to quantum degeneracy
arxiv-2201-05143.creator: Andreas Schindewolf, Roman Bause, Xing-Yan Chen, Marcel Duda, Tijs Karman, Immanuel Bloch, Xin-Yu Luo
arxiv-2201-05143.description: Abstract Ultracold polar molecules offer strong electric dipole moments and rich internal structure, which makes them ideal building blocks to explore exotic quantum matter Baranov2002 ; Cooper2009 ; Shi2010 ; Wu2016 ; Schmidt2021 ; Bruun2008 ; Matveeva2012 ; Baranov2012 , implement novel quantum information schemes DeMille2002 ; Yelin2006 ; Ni2018 , or test fundamental symmetries of nature Safronova2018 .

arxiv-2210-14374.title: A computational model of twisted elastic ribbons
arxiv-2210-14374.creator: Madelyn Leembruggen, Jovana Andrejevic, Arshad Kudrolli, Chris H. Rycroft
arxiv-2210-14374.description: Abstract We develop an irregular lattice mass-spring-model (MSM) to simulate and study the deformation modes of a thin elastic ribbon as a function of applied end-to-end twist and tension. Our simulations reproduce all reported experimentally observed modes, including transitions from helicoids to longitudinal wrinkles, creased helicoids and loops with self-contact, and transverse wrinkles to accordion self-folds.

arxiv-2311-02052.title: Extreme Axions Unveiled: a Novel Fluid Approach for Cosmological Modeling
arxiv-2311-02052.creator: Harrison Winch, Renée Hložek, David J. E. Marsh, Daniel Grin, Keir K. Rogers
arxiv-2311-02052.description: Abstract Axion-like particles (ALPs) are a well-motivated dark matter candidate that solve some of the problems in the clustering of large scale structure in cosmology. ALPs are often described by a simplified quadratic potential to specify the dynamics of the axion field, and are included in cosmological analysis codes using a modified fluid prescription.

arxiv-2403-07044.title: The Effect of Quark-antiquark Confinement on the Deflection Angle by the NED Black Hole
arxiv-2403-07044.creator: Erdem Sucu, Ali Övgün
arxiv-2403-07044.description: Abstract In this study, we explore the influence of quark-antiquark confinement on the deflection angle within the framework of nonlinear electrodynamic (NED) black holes. To achieve this, we establish the appropriate optical spacetime metric and subsequently determine the Gaussian optical curvature.

arxiv-2408-04477.title: What You Need is What You Get: Theory of Mind for an LLM-Based Code Understanding Assistant
arxiv-2408-04477.creator: Jonan Richards , Mairieli Wessel
arxiv-2408-04477.description: Abstract A growing number of tools have used Large Language Models (LLMs) to support developers’ code understanding. However, developers still face several barriers to using such tools, including challenges in describing their intent in natural language, interpreting the tool outcome, and refining an effective prompt to obtain useful information.

arxiv-2511-06115.title: DiLO: Disentangled Latent Optimization for Learning Shape and Deformation in Grouped Deforming 3D Objects
arxiv-2511-06115.creator: Mostofa Rafid Uddin 1 , Jana Armouti 1 , Umong Sain 2 , Md Asib Rahman 2 , Xingjian Li 1 , Min Xu 1,† 1 Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, PA 15213, USA. 2 Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh † Corresponding Author: Min Xu (mxu1@cs.cmu.edu)
arxiv-2511-06115.description: Abstract In this work, we propose a disentangled latent optimization-based method for parameterizing grouped deforming 3D objects into shape and deformation factors in an unsupervised manner. Our approach involves the joint optimization of a generator network along with the shape and deformation factors, supported by specific regularization techniques.

arxiv-2601-11120.description: Abstract The first four all-sky surveys with eROSITA the soft X-ray instrument on board the Spektrum-Roentgen-Gamma (SRG) satellite revealed a new X-ray source, eRASSU J012422.9 − - 724248, in the Magellanic Bridge, near the Eastern Wing of the Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC). We performed a broadband timing and spectral analysis using the optical and X-ray data of eRASSU J012422.
